steps.text: Note: To access the DLC, you need to have killed both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood.
Talk to Leda at the Cocoon of the Empyrean.
Touch Miquella's withered arm to enter the realm of shadow. The Gravesite Plain grace lies just outside the cave where you spawn.
From the grace, head northeast to a stele with Map: Gravesite Plain by the road.
Just north of the stele lies the Scorched Ruins:
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the lower east side of the ruins.
Continue up the east side to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1] on a broken staircase.
On a higher up ledge next to the staircase sits a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x5.
From the ledge, jump onto the west balcony, then toward the covered bridge connecting both sides of the ruins to reach a corpse with Black Pyrefly x3.
On the lower west side of the ruins, behind some breakable jars, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [2].
Go up the stairs near the jars and pick up Furlcalling Finger Remedy x2 from the roof around the right corner.
Head across the covered bridge and grab the Blade of Mercy from the tower at the end.
Grab the Scorched Ruins grace just north past the ruins and pass time until nightfall.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the graveyard to the east of the grace for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Pick up Black Pyrefly x3 from the corpse in the graveyard.
Follow the cliff near the graveyeard southeast to reach a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Continue along the cliff edge to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves (that only appear at night).
From the blue spiritgraves, head southwest to find Lump of Flesh x2 behind a stone arch near the cliff edge.
Explore the woods east of the arch to encounter Logur, the Beast Claw. Kill him to obtain the Beast Claw.
His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Savage Claws. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Follow the road near the woods down to a wagon with a Glass Shard, Black Pyrefly, and Arrow x10 close by.
Kill the Black Knight in the church down the road for the Black Steel Greathammer, then grab the Scadutree Fragment x2 in front of the statue.
In a cave opening near the cliff behind the church, you'll find a Blessing of Marika.
On the other side of the church lies a small encampment. Pick up Fire Coil x2 from one of the tents.
Return to the Scorched Ruins and head northeast to an opening in the cliff and grab "The Sacred Tower" Painting inside.
Pick up the Backhand Blade beside a coffin in the middle of some spiral pillars.
This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Blind Spot. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
From the coffin, continue north-northwest to a stone arch with a Grave Glovewort [5] next to it.
Head toward the Miquella's Cross near the road and exhaust Hornsent's dialogue to receive the Cross Map.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to the cross and grab the Three-Path Cross grace.
Exhaust Freyja's dialogue next to the grace.
Follow the road west to discover another cross. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to it and grab the Main Gate Cross grace.
Exhaust Ansbach's dialogue, then reload the area and ask him about the person in verdigris armor.
Talk to Moore and buy an item from him to unlock some additional dialogue.
From the grace, head southeast to a path in the cliffside and pick up Smithing Stone [5] x4 from the ledge.
Continue up the cliffside path to reach the Cliffroad Terminus grace.
In the graveyard southwest of the grace, kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the graveyard.
Look for a pot hanging from the cliff east of the corpse. Shoot it down with a ranged weapon and pick up the String-Seller's Bell Bearing.
In the ruins near the cliff, climb the wall covered in fabric to enter Prospect Town:
Pick up Beast Blood x2 from the open building.
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3 on the ground.
Head up the slanted pillar to reach the upper section, then kill one of the Bloodfiends for the Bloodfiend's Arm (first time).
Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x2 from the arcade and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] down the stairs north of it.
Loot the Outer God Heirloom from a chest in the top building.
Return to the grace, pass time until nightfall, then follow the east cliff edge to a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Head up the hill southwest of the statue to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Interact with the friendly Kindred of Rot (Forager Brood) on the hill to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [2] and Black Pyrefly x3.
Note: Do not attack any of the Forager Brood. They are non-hostile, and killing them will end Moore's questline early.
Pick up Great Arrow x10, Sacred Bloody Flesh x2, and Smithing Stone [5] x4 from a small campsite with two corpses just below the hill.
Follow the path near the campsite into the woods to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5] on some rocks next to a large sheep.
At the end of the woods are two paths. Climb the rocky slope first to grab the "Incursion" Painting from the shack at the top.
Head back and follow the cliffside path down to a church. Pick up the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman in front of the statue.
Grab the Oathseeker Knight Set and Pata from a corpse hanging off the cliff behind the church.
Travel to the Scorched Ruins and head west to a mausoleum. Kill the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside for Greatsword of Solitude, Solitude Set, and 70,000 runes.
Kill the Furnace Golem near the Scorched Ruins for the Deflecting Hardtear and a Furnace Visage.
From the Three-Path Cross, head northwest along the cliff to reach a campsite with Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw.

links.label: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw

steps.text: In the lower field northwest of the campsite, next to a stone arch by the cliff, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [1].
On the small hill just northeast of the stone arch, you'll find the Serpent Crest Shield (painting reward).
Kill the Ghostflame Dragon in the lake for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 100,000 runes.
Grab the Great Katana from a corpse in front of the dragon.
This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Overhead Stance. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
At the west end of the lake lies the entrance to Belurat Gaol:
Head inside and grab the Belurat Gaol grace down the stairs.
Enter the first cell on the left to pick up Frozen Maggot x6.
After the stairs collapse, enter the nearby cell for a Silver Horn Tender next to some crates.
Cross the narrow passage to find Frozen Maggot x4 on a corpse hanging off the ledge.
Jump through the hole in the next room, then continue to a Broken Rune between two tables.
Pick up Thawfrost Boluses from the ledge just outside the table room.
Continue to a circular room. Before dropping down, enter the cell to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3].
Descend the pots in the circular room and pick up Glass Shard from the corpse on top of a pot halfway down.
From the corpse, drop onto the west pot to reach a wooden ledge. Grab a Hefty Cracked Pot from the chest on the ledge.
Continue until the floor collapses, then follow the only path forward in the maze to find Lost Ashes of War in front of some boxes.
Follow either southwest path to a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x3. The nearby gate is the exit, so remember it for later.
Climb the slanted pots near the corpse to enter another maze, then climb the pots in the back to reach the Innard Meat and Hefty Cracked Pot on top of the pots.
Next to another set of slanted pots lies a corpse with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [11].
Climb the second set of slanted pots, then follow either path to a Hefty Cracked Pot on top of some pots at the end.
Drop down to return to the exit gate, then pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from a cage on the right.
Instead of dropping down to the boss, drop onto the west pot lift below the cliff and continue to an altar with the Greatjar on top.
Descend the pots below the east-side corner to return, then kill Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze for Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh and 80,000 runes.
From the gaol entrance, head north to find the Gravebird Armor in front of a stone arch.
Head east-northeast from the arch to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3, guarded by two dogs.
Just past the corpse lies a shack with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10].
On the ledge above the shack lies a corpse with Fly Mold x3.
Head around the ledge to discover the Greatbridge, North grace outside the Abandoned Ailing Village:
Pass time until nightfall, then grab the Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves near the cliff.
Follow the cliff edge up to a corpse with Black Pyrefly x2 and a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash just past it.
A corpse with Human Bone Shard lies on the upper ledge near the statue.
In a house west of the corpse, you'll find a Broken Rune.
Pick up the Ailment Talisman from a wooden platform at the top of the village.
Return to the grace and head below the greatbridge to find a shack with 2x Furnace Visage and Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2].
From the Three-Path Cross, follow the north-northeast road and loot the Ballista Bolt x5, Lost Ashes of War, and Shadow Realm Rune [1] on the greatbridge.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of a statue at the fork in the road, then grab the Castle Front grace next to the castle bridge.
Drop down to the left of the castle bridge, then follow the slope down to a castle room with the Spelldrake Talisman +3.
Head toward the top of the slope, then go north past some spiked barricades and pick up the Black Pyrefly x5 under a canopy.
On a higher up ledge past the canopy sits a corpse with Messmerfire Grease and Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Continue north until you reach the entrance to Fog Rift Catacombs:
Take the lift down and grab the Fog Rift Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the first corridor.
Reach the room with a Bigmouth Imp firing at you from a ledge, then grab the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] from the east corridor.
Trigger the impaling mechanism down the opposite room without dropping, then jump onto it to reach a ledge with Knot Resin x3.
Go through the corridor on top of the mechanism to reach a room with a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Approach the closest arch outside the room without dropping to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump across it to reach a coffin with Black Knight Commander Andreas.
Return to the room with the Bigmouth Imp on a ledge, then pick up Dragonbolt Grease x2 from the west room floor.
Take the lift down, then pick up Rada Fruit x4 from the corpse below the staircase.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [6] from the corpse in the west room.
In the large room, drop down the hole in the second alcove on the left. After landing, grab the Ghost Glovewort [5] at the east end.
Pick up Electrocharge from the corpse in the west room near the ladder.
Climb the ladder and return to the large room, then pick up Glass Shard from the third alcove on the left.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from the coffin at the south end of the room.
Stand near the balustrade to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump inside it to reach a chest with Ash of War: Blinkbolt.
Run along the top of the mechanism to reach a stele with the Stone-Sheathed Sword.
Descend the ladder near the stele to enter a small room with a Ghost Glovewort [6].
Drop down to the large room, then enter the room on the west side for a Broken Rune below another impaling mechanism.
Take the lift down and kill the Death Knight for Death Knight's Twin Axes, Crimson Amber Medallion +3, and 110,000 runes.
Travel to Castle Front and pick up Fire Knight's Cookbook [2] from a tent in the west-southwest part of the encampment.
In the encampment opposite the road sits a chest with the Firespark Perfume Bottle.
Drop down the ledges in the cliff southeast of the chest. Near the lower far-right cliff, in front of a tent, lies the Spread Crossbow.
At the edge of the cliff, just northwest from the tent, is a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x3.
Follow the cliff past the battlefield of enemies to reach the entrance to the Ruined Forge Lava Intake:
Enter the forge and grab the Ruined Forge Lava Intake grace.
After descending the ladder, take the first left to a room with Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [6] x6.
Head down to a balcony with Smithing Stone [3], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [5] x4.
Continue to a large room with a ladder. Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [1] around the corner behind the ladder.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1], Smithing Stone [4], and 2x Smithing Stone [3] next to the Golem Smith near the ladder.
Next to the staircase opposite the Golem Smith is a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Grab the Smithing Stone [4] in the middle of the room, then pick up the Smithing Stone [1] at the end.
Head around the wall and grab the Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [3], and Somber Smithing Stone [7] next to a Golem Smith.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Smithing Stone [3] and Greater Potentate's Cookbook [13] around the corner.
Head up the broken structure and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x3 and 2x Smithing Stone [1] on the top platform.
Jump across the broken wall to reach a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x5 on the roof of the furnace.
Return to the top platform and descend the ladder there. Pull the lever, then grab the Smithing Stone [1] and Glass Shard behind it.
Drop down and loot the 2x Smithing Stone [4] and Smithscript Dagger on the ground.
Jump onto the pipe and climb it to the top room. Examine the altar to obtain the Anvil Hammer and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
From the forge entrance, head down the northeast slope until you reach a poison swamp. Then head south to find a corpse with Festive Grease in a patch of flowers.
Head back across the poison swamp and pick up Toxic Mossling x8 from a corpse against the rocks.
In the poison swamp farther east, behind a Miranda Blossom, lies the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [7].
Head along the southeast cliff until you reach a shack with Talisman of the Dread.
Destroy the stacked stones on the ledge northwest of the shack (or use Margit's Shackle) to unseal the spiritspring. It can be used to reach Scadu Altus without having to go through Castle Ensis.
Travel to Castle Front and follow the east-southeast road into the woods. Pick up the Swift Spear next to a campfire by the road.
Continue to a fork, then take the left path to discover the Pillar Path Cross grace and a Scadutree Fragment.
Talk to Thiollier sitting next to the cross.
Travel to the Main Gate Cross and talk to Moore to receive the Black Syrup.
Give Thiollier the Black Syrup, ask him about it, then tell him that you're weary of life to receive Thiollier's Concoction.
Return to the fork in the road and follow the other path to a Grave Glovewort [6] near some gravestones.
Continue uphill and grab the Pillar Path Waypoint grace at another fork in the road.
Pass time until nightfall, then head up south toward a stone platform with Gravebird Bracelets.
In the upper meadow southeast of the stone platform, you'll find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Head toward the tower at the top. Below a ledge behind it is a small campsite with Smithing Stone [6] x4.
Take the lift inside the tower and loot the chest at the top for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Return to Pillar Path Waypoint and talk to Igon near the grace.
Follow the path past Igon to be invaded by Ancient Dragon-Man. Kill him for 24,519 runes.
Look for a pot hanging from a cliff above one of the headless dragon statues. Shoot it down to obtain Herbalist's Bell Bearing.
Continue along the path to reach the entrance to Dragon's Pit:
Enter the cave and grab the Dragon's Pit grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x4 from the southwest end of the first room.
Continue to the next room and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [2] in front of the urn sculpture.
Kill the Magma Wyrm up the stairs in the next room to obtain a Dragon Heart and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Pick up Knot Resin x4 and Smithing Stone [5] x3 from the room with the Magma Wyrm.
Go down the stairs in the previous room, then take the plunge. After landing, turn around for Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Kill Ancient Dragon-Man for the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana and 130,000 runes.
Open the door and grab the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace for later.
Ascend the stairs near Main Gate Cross and enter Belurat. Pick up Revered Spirit Ash x2 from the statue in the first room.
Behind the statue sits a corpse with a Shadow Realm Rune [1].
Grab the Fireproof Dried Liver guarded by a Spider Scorpion up the stairs.
Continue up the stairs for a corpse with Black Pyrefly x5.
At the top of the stairs, you'll discover the Belurat, Tower Settlement grace.
A corpse with Neutralizing Boluses lies in the room next to the grace.
Head through the alley and pick up the Stimulating Boluses in front of the fountain.
Grab the Knot Resin x3 in front of the waterfall, but watch out for the ambush.
Go up the stairs, then turn right for a Somber Smithing Stone [5] next to another fountain.
Take the first right at the street to find a corpse with Messmerfire Grease.
At the end of the street lies a corpse with Black Pyrefly x3.
Destroy the jars in the nearby room to reveal a Silver Horn Tender.
Head up the stairs and grab the Small Private Altar grace.
Take a left when exiting the room, then cross the rooftops closest to the grace to reach a Silver Horn Tender on the last roof.
Go back to the bridge, then cross the rooftops on the other side of the street to reach a corpse with Silver Horn Tender x2, Golden Horn Tender x2, and a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Return to the grace and take the other path up the stairs. Follow the street down to a plaza, where you'll be invaded by Fire Knight Queelign. Defeat him to obtain the Crusade Insignia.
Loot the Dewgem x3, Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow, and Black Pyrefly x3 in the plaza.

links.label: Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow

steps.text: Climb the rubble in the corner of the plaza to reach a corpse with Arrow x10 above the entrance.
Exit the plaza and grab the Black Pyrefly x2 and Thin Beast Bones x4 on the rooftops near the street.
Go through the alley past the rooftops and pick up Redflesh Mushroom x5 from the corpse in the water.
At the brink of the waterfall lies a corpse with String x4.
Climb the ladder in the nearby room to find a corpse with the Storeroom Key.
Take a left down the stairs when exiting the room to find Throwing Dagger x3 at the end of the broken bridge.
From the top of the stairs, take a right onto the rooftops and pick up the Flight Pinion x4 on the first roof.
On the second roof lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x2.
Drop onto the corner of the roof southwest of the corpse to reach a room with the Well Depths Key and Whiteflesh Mushroom x6
Return to the top of the stairs, then go left twice and ride the lift down the stairs. Pull the lever to unlock the door to the first grace.
Proceed through Belurat like before, but this time, descend the well near the second fountain. Pick up Messmerfire Grease from the pile of corpses there.
Unlock the well depths door and head southwest toward two fallen towers. Pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from the roof of a building near the towers.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the area past the fallen towers for the Immunizing Horn Charm +2.
Loot the Thin Beast Bones x8, Sliver of Meat x2, Broken Rune, Smithing Stone [5] x2, and Poisonbone Dart x8 in the swamp.
Head the other direction until you come to a bridge. Grab the Neutralizing Boluses in the left corner between two buildings just before the bridge.
Pick up Serpent Arrow x8 from the top of a building on an island of rubble past the bridge.
Kill the Horned Warrior north of the building for the Horned Warrior's Sword, then grab the Beast Liver x3 he's guarding.
Grab the Poisoned Hand next to a building in the poison, then pick up Knot Resin x5 from the other island.
Head south-southeast toward a tower with a ladder, then continue south toward a tree in the poison. Just past it is a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x4.
Climb the ladder in front of the tower and unlock the shortcut back to the grace.
Ride the lift near the grace again, then at the top of the stairs, enter the room straight ahead to pick up the Bone Bow.
When exiting the room, climb the rubble on the left to reach a room with Thin Beast Bones x5.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment in the next room and touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross at the tower.
Exit the room and pick up Dried Bouquet from the small building outside.
Drop down west of the building and grab the Fly Mold x4, Redflesh Mushroom x8, Stanching Boluses, and Glass Shard around the water.
Follow the water to a room with a Broken Rune and a ladder.
Climb the ladder, then take a left across the covered bridge and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for a Revered Spirit Ash and Golden Horn Tender (first time).
A corpse with Black Pyrefly x3 lies on the left after crossing the bridge.
Go back across the bridge and continue along the street. Pick up Black Pyrefly x4 from the corpse hanging off the left edge.
Pick up a Revered Spirit Ash from the statue on the nearby altar.
Enter the circular tower and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [5] on the bottom end of the staircase.
Make your way up the stairs and grab the Stagefront grace at the top.
Open the door and kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion for Remembrance of the Dancing Lion and 120,000 runes.
If you summon Freyja for the boss, she'll have some additional dialogue afterward.
Pick up the Divine Beast Head dropped by the boss, then grab the Theatre of the Divine Beast grace.
Take the nearby lift, then after opening the door, pick up the Revered Spirit Ash on the statue.
Grab the Tower of Shadow Message at the top of the giant staircase.
Travel to the Small Private Altar and unlock the storeroom at the end of the bridge. Exhaust Hornsent Grandam's dialogue while wearing the Divine Beast Head to receive Watchful Spirit.
Open the shortcut door at the other side of the storeroom.
Talk to Hornsent Grandam after reloading the area to receive a Scorpion Stew.
Give Hornsent a Scorpion Stew, then talk to him again to receive Furnace Visage x3. If you've entered Scadu Altus, Hornsent will be located at the Highroad Cross.
Obtain another Scorpion Stew from Hornsent Grandam and attempt to give it to Hornsent.
If you summoned Freyja for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, ask her about the damage to her helm, then ask about that other man.
Talk to Ansbach about the cross at the tower.
From Castle Front, head east-southeast toward the mountain wall, then follow it to a Grave Glovewort [5] on the cliff edge.
Descend the ledges below the cliff to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [1] on a lower ledge.
Enter the tunnel at the bottom, then pick up Deep-Purple Lily from the corpse on the ledge.
Pick up the Revered Spirit Ash farther in, then grab the Ellac River Cave grace just past it.
Follow the river northwest until you're ambushed by an Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Kill it to obtain Horned Bairn.
A Shadow Realm Rune [2] lies on the rock that juts from the water where you were ambushed.
Hug the right side while continuing upstream to discover an alcove with Fly Mold x3.
Continue along the river to find a Silver Horn Tender on top of a pile of corpses.
Go through the waterfall at the end to discover a room with the Two-Headed Turtle Talisman.
Head toward the cliff edge southwest of the waterfall, then turn around and shoot down the pot hanging from the cliff face to obtain Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [1].
On the opposite side of the cliff face lies the entrance to Rivermouth Cave:
Head inside and activate the Rivermouth Cave grace.
Pick up the Hefty Beast Bone x2 guarded by some wolves in the first room.
Past the first room, go right for an alcove with Sliver of Meat x3.
Step on the crack in the floor up the rocks in the next room. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [1] after landing.
Continue to a cavern, then follow the right path to a corpse with Sacred Bloody Flesh.
Return to the cavern. Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x6 from the corpse in the alcove and Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 from the altar.
Kill the Chief Bloodfiend for Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes and 80,000 runes.
Travel to Ellac River Cave and head downstream. Pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [12] on a rocky platform past the waterfall.
Continue past the second waterfall and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] guarded by Gravebirds.
A Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone lies at the base of the second waterfall, guarded by a Crayfish that drops Smithing Stone [8] x3 and a Strip of White Flesh (first time).
Drop down the third waterfall to find a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x6 next to a tall rock in the water.
Grab the Ellac River Downstream grace on dry land near the tall rock.
Shoot down the pot hanging in front of the last waterfall to obtain Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2].
Head east into the woods to find a friendly Forager Brood near the cliff. Interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [3] and Yellow Fulgurbloom x3.
Pick up the Lightning Perfume Bottle from the pond in the woods.
Kill the Furnace Golem patrolling the river for the Viridian Hidden Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Note: This one can also be killed from above in Charo's Hidden Grave if you're struggling.
Follow the wooded path on the other side of the river to the Cerulean Coast grace.
From the Cerulean Coast grace, head southwest toward a stone coffin shaped like a ship. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] on top of it.
Pick up another Grave Glovewort [9] from the stone coffin northwest of the first.
Continue west while sticking to the right side of the water to find a Grave Glovewort [7] near some Gravebirds.
Pick up Spiritgrave Stone x2, Lost Ashes of War, Shadow Realm Rune [3], and String x3 from the corpses in the water.
Grab the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1] next to the large dead tree by the water.
In the area northwest of the dead tree, you'll discover the Cerulean Coast West grace.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [6] next to some graves just north-northwest of the grace.
Climb the stone coffin next to the grace and grab the Grave Glovewort [8] on top of it.
Head through the nearby ravine and pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x4 in front of a large gravestone, guarded by a Demi-Human Swordsman that drops Starlight Shards (first time).
Explore the dead end east of the gravestone to find a corpse with the Spirit Sword.
Return to the large gravestone, then head north while sticking to the right side to discover an alcove with a Scadutree Fragment.
Continue to the beach and kill Demi-Human Queen Marigga for the Star-Lined Sword and 100,000 runes.
Pick up a Great Grave Glovewort from the stone coffin on the beach.
Return to Cerulean Coast West and head southeast back to the large dead tree. Descend the cave below the tree, then follow the tunnel east to a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Continue up the tunnel to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.
Go back down the tunnel and follow it to a corpse with Crab Eggs x2, guarded by a Crayfish.
Head through the rest of the tunnel, then grab the Perfumed Oil of Ranah from the top of the cave exit.
Enter the mausoleum on the other side of the island and kill the Dancer of Ranah for Dancing Blade of Ranah, Dancer's Set and 80,000 runes.
Kill the Ghostflame Dragon south of the Cerulean Coast grace for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
Loot the Human Bone Shard, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Grave Cricket x6 on the outer edge of one of the islands.
Grab another Grave Cricket x6 from the corpse in front of a large gravestone on the last island.
Go up the slope past the last island to find a stele with Map: Southern Shore.
From the stele, head south-southeast and up the hillside with the cross to discover the Cerulean Coast Cross grace.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment, then touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross at the coast.
Head northwest and climb the stone coffin above the map stele for a Grave Glovewort [9].
Follow the road near the coffin southwest to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x4.
Take out the Troll throwing pots at you to obtain a Hefty Cracked Pot.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the large stone coffin past the road.
Head through the left side of the meadow past the coffin to find St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2] at the top.
Find a way down the massive hole, then grab the Shadow Realm Rune [1] on a lower ledge.
Continue down the hole to reach a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x3, then activate The Fissure grace at the bottom for later.
Return to Cerulean Coast Cross and head north to reach the top of a coffin with a Grave Glovewort [9].
Drop down from the east end of the coffin, then drop down the cliff below it to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.
Return to the previous coffin, then from its edge, jump toward an area with a dead tree. Pick up St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1] next to it.
Pick up a Great Grave Glovewort from the stone coffin north-northeast of the dead tree.
Head east-southeast toward the beach until you see a corpse with Arrow x10 in the shallow water.
Go up the zigzag slope with cerulean flowers to find Smithing Stone [6] x3 next to two large gravestones.
Head back down and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [2] at the end of the beach.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [9] from the large stone coffin to the northwest.
Follow the path from the stone coffin to discover the Finger Ruins of Rhia grace.
Going down the slope, you'll come to a fork. The upward path leads to a coffin that can duplicate any remembrance. Optionally, mark it on your map for later use.
Head to the bottom, then go west toward the slope with cerulean flowers. Follow it until you reach a shack with Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1].
Talk to Ansbach about the cross at the coast.
Travel to the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace and exit east-southeast. At the edge of the cliff overlooking the drake, you can find a message left by Igon.
Kill the Jagged Peak Drake for Dragon Heart, Dragonscale Flesh, and 90,000 runes.
Go through the ravine south of the dragon and pick up Red Fulgurbloom x3 from the upper east ledge near the end.
Pick up Igon's Cookbook [1] from the remains of a tower past the ravine.
Approach the massive dragon corpse and grab the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion grace next to it.
Talk to Florissax and agree to devour draconic essence to receive an Ancient Dragon's Blessing.
Talk to Florissax again and ask her about Bayle.
Examine the altar behind her and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Pick up the 3x Dragon Communion Harpoon on the dragon's wing (the third is on the lowest part of the wing).
Grab the Dragon Communion Grease in front of a smaller dragon corpse on the other side of the massive dragon.
Enter the area with crimson flowers near the tail, then grab the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2] behind some rocks in the water.
Kill the Tibia Mariner in the water to obtain Tibia's Cookbook.
Head up the rightmost slope and grab the Grave Glovewort [9] amidst some gravestones at the top.
Continue up the northwest slope to reach a corpse with Rings of Spectral Light below a large Gravebird statue.
Pick up the Call of Tibia next to some gravestones northeast of the statue.
Head back down and grab the Charo's Hidden Grave grace past the water.
Follow the cliff edge southeast until you see a stone coffin below the cliff. Drop onto it for a Great Grave Glovewort.
Return to the grace and kill the Death Rite Bird in the water past the arch for Ash of War: Ghostflame Call and 230,000 runes.
Follow the water southwest and grab the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [14] behind a Miranda Blossom.
Head up the slope behind the Miranda Blossom and kill the Hippopotamus in the water for a Scadutree Fragment.
Pick up Ghostflame Bloom x4 from the corpse in the water.
Return to the grace and follow the right path after the arch to find the Spirit Glaive next to some gravestones up the middle slope.
If you didn't kill the Furnace Golem in Ellac River, you can do it now by throwing Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket from the ledge below.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] at the edge of the water after dropping down south-southwest of the Spirit Glaive.
Follow the water down to an area with multiple cages, then continue along the trail to find a Ghost Glovewort [8] guarded by Spirit Eels.
Return along the trail to the cages outside the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol:
Head inside and grab the Lamenter's Gaol grace.
Loot the Gaol Upper Level Key from a chest in the room just before the stone bridge.
Go across the stone bridge and pick up the Prattling Pate "Lamentation" at the end.
Unlock the door at the start and descend the ladder inside. Grab the Chilling Perfume Bottle from the first room on the right.
Drop down the hole opposite the first room, then turn around to pick up Innard Meat x2.
Follow the tunnel to a fork, then enter the room straight ahead to find the Clarifying Horn Charm +2.
Climb the ladder in the other room, then explore until the floor collapses. Enter the first cell up the stairs to find a Call of Tibia.
Hit the illusory wall outside the room to reveal another cell, but you don't have the key for it yet.
Go through the second cell up the stairs to reach a large room. Pick up the Hefty Cracked Pot on a mountain of corpses.
Loot the Gaol Lower Level Key from a chest farther in and pick up Living Jar Shard x6 from the nearby corpse.
Unlock the cell behind the illusory wall to reach a room with a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and the Lamenting Visage.
Head through the top cell and unlock the door in the room below. Kill the Lamenter for Lamenter's Mask and 160,000 runes.
Go up the slope south-southeast of the entrance, then follow the west-northwest cliff edge to a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Continue up the hillside and grab the Fireproof Pickled Liver at the upper end of the water.
Take the spiritspring at the top, then kill the Furnace Golem for the Glovewort Crystal Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Note: This one has armored legs, which means you'll have to throw Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket to kill it.
After taking out the Furnace Golem, you can safely loot the Gravebird Ashes near the top.
Travel to Castle Front and grab the Black Pyrefly x3 on the bridge to the castle bridge.
Kill the Troll Knight past the bridge for a Somber Smithing Stone [9] and Royal Magic Grease x3.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [4] from the building on the right.
Go around the building to find a Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the lower roof.
A Somber Smithing Stone [5] lies on the cliff edge opposite the building.
Walk around the ledge halfway up the stairs to reach a corpse with a Broken Rune.
Go left at the top of the slope, then climb the ladder to a chest with the Milady.
Pick up Flight Pinion x2 from the corpse on the ground past the short tunnel.
Loot the Loyal Knight's Cookbook from a chest in the building halfway up the slope.
Drop down the cliff west of the building to reach a corpse with Bolt x10 on a lower ledge.
Go through the short tunnel behind the corpse to reach a ledge with Glintslab Firefly x3.
Return to the slope and grab the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot in a dead end on the right.
Pick up the Castle Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment by the cross.
Activate the Castle Ensis Checkpoint grace and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] behind it.
Pick up Knot Resin x3 from a lower ledge opposite the cross.
Drop to the bottom and pick up Arrow x10 from the corpse guarded by three dogs.
Continue to a cliff, then go right to reach a rooftop with Starlight Shards.
Follow the cliff up the waterfall, then continue upstream to find Drawstring Royal Magic Grease x3 below the waterfall at the end.
A corpse with Knot Resin x4 sits in the cave behind the waterfall.
Climb the ladder near the waterfall and push the lever to open the gate back to the grace.
Cross the bridge past the gate and pick up String x3 from the cliff on the left.
A corpse with a Glintslab Firefly lies on the cliff edge up ahead.
Climb the ladder in the grassy area beside the stairs to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Go up the stairs and kill Moonrithyll, Carian Knight to obtain Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.
Pick up Rellana's Cameo from the altar past Moonrithyll and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [2] in the corridor.
On the staircase up ahead lies a corpse with a Glintslab Firefly.
Open the spiked gate, then drop down to the left to reach a corpse with Dewgem x3.
Climb the two ladders, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] at the end of the rooftop.
Drop down from the northeast side of the rooftop to reach a corpse with Glintblade Trio.
Drop down again and loot the Wolf Crest Shield from the chest in the room.
Return to the spiked gate and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] and Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the rampart.
Go up the stairs at the end of the rampart and loot an Imbued Sword Key from the chest in the tower.
Take the lift up and activate the Castle-Lord's Chamber grace.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the balcony near the grace.
Jump over the balcony, drop down to the tower below, then climb it to a chest with Ash of War: Wing Stance at the top.
Return to Castle-Lord's Chamber and kill Rellana, Twin Moon Knight for Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight and 240,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

steps.text: Leda's summon sign can be found next to the entrance.
Grab the Ensis Moongazing Grounds grace after the fight.
Head toward the cross past the Ensis Moongazing Grounds. Grab the Scadutree Fragment and Highroad Cross grace.
Pick up the Monk's Missive and May the Best Win gesture on the broken stone fence.
Talk to Hornsent to receive the New Cross Map.
Talk to Leda and ask her about the hornsent.
Kill the Troll Knight patrolling the water west of the grace for Smithing Stone [8] x9.
Head toward the south end of the water, then pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [2] from the tower near the right edge of the cliff.
Drop onto the castle section below the cliff to reach a chest with the Carian Sorcery Sword.
Jump onto the battlement behind the chest, then drop down on the southwest side to reach an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Head west-northwest from the Highroad Cross to the wooded area across the water to find the Scadu Altus, West grace near the cliff.
Unlock the imp-sealed belfry on the island southeast of the grace. Take the sending gate to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
After arriving at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, pick up Beast Horn x2 from a ledge on the left side of the water.
Head along the water to find the Verdigris Discus in front of a statue below the arcade.
Behind one of the pillars south of the statue lies a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom.
Return to Scadu Altus, West and drop down the ledges near the waterfall to find a gravestone with a Grave Glovewort [8].
Head back to the grace again and descend the ledges west of it to reach Fog Rift Fort:
Pick up the Fire Arrow x10 in front of some explosive barrels.
A corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x8 sits in the first tower.
Go down the scaffolding around the tower and pick up Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3] from the other side of the bridge.
Descend the ladder at the end of the rampart and grab the Messmerfire Grease in front of two flamespitters.
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Serpent Flail.
Head back up and kill Black Knight Garrew for Black Steel Greatshield and 80,000 runes.
Loot the chest in the building to obtain Blessed Bone Shard x3 and Smithing Stone [8] x6.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the rampart southwest of the building.
Drop down at the other side of the building, then climb to the top for a chest with the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman.
Travel to Highroad Cross and pass time until nightfall. Follow the road until you see a stele with Map: Scadu Altus.
Head west from the stele to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves to the left of the church.
Fire Knight Queelign invades inside the church. Defeat him to obtain Ash of War: Flame Skewer and the Prayer Room Key.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment x2 and Rune Arc in the church.

A wounded Forager Brood lies on the cliff next to the church. Use a Warming Stone to heal it, then after reloading the area, interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [4] and Shadow Sunflower x3.
Head back to the map stele by the road, then pick up Black Pyrefly x3 from the corpse at the entrance to the encampment.
Quickly grab the Scadutree Fragment on the stone fence to the right, just past the entrance, then return to the map stele.
From the stele, head east-northeast to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves on the left.
Head southeast into the woods to find a corpse with the Highland Warrior Set near a pond.
Kill Ralva the Great Red Bear in the pond for Pelt of Ralva and 180,000 runes
Back at the map stele, follow the southeast road to a cross on the left. Grab the Moorth Ruins grace and Scadutree Fragment next to it.
Use the May the Best Win gesture near Dryleaf Dane to challenge him. After you beat him, pick up the Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat next to the cross.
His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Palm Blast. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Enter the camp across the road from Moorth Ruins and grab the Scadutree Fragment in front of the statue.
Inside one of the tents lies a corpse with the Fire Knight's Cookbook [1].
Pick up the Hefty Beast Bone x4, Shadow Realm Rune [2], and Lump of Flesh x2 in the pond southwest of the camp.
On the other side of the hill southeast of the pond, between two pillars, is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Amidst the ruins southeast of the scarab sits a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2.
Between two fallen pillars just west of the corpse, you'll find an exploding scarab that drops Ash of War: Piercing Throw.
Shoot down the scarab hanging from a pillar to the left of the forge for another Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Head northwest past the forge and toward the cliff to find a Forager Brood and a corpse with a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Interact with the Forager Brood to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [1] and Glintslab Firefly x3.
Head back and enter the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past:
Descend the ladder and grab the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [6] x5, and Smithing Stone [5] from the first half of the room.
Grab the Smithscript Spear and 2x Smithing Stone [2] in the other half of the room, and pull the lever.
Drop down and loot the 3x Smithing Stone [3] and Smithing Stone [2] on the floor.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [3], and 2x Smithing Stone [2] in the second room.
Grab the Smithing Stone [5] in an alcove in the corridor.
At the end of the corridor is a small room with a Somber Smithing Stone [8] and a Smithing Stone [3].
Climb the ladder in the corridor and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the back of the room.
Go up the stairs and across the raised platform to enter a room with Smithing Stone [3], 2x Smithing Stone [6], and the Smithing Talisman.
Drop onto the bridge below the raised platform, then turn around to pick up Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Glass Shard on the other side, and pull the lever.
Head through the lowered gate to reach a room with a Smithing Stone [5], Smithscript Cirque, and Smithing Stone [6].
Pull the lever in the corridor, then stand on the gate as it rises. Examine the altar to obtain the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Follow the road near Moorth Ruins to a dragon fighting soldiers. To the left of the dragon is a sealed spiritspring. Unseal it by hitting the stacked stones at the east end of the cliff.
Take the spiritspring up, then make your way to the top to discover the Scaduview Cross grace.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross where the eye was abandoned.
Return to the bottom of the spiritspring, then head north-northeast toward a statue on the cliff holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner below the ledge west-southwest of the statue for a Scadutree Fragment and Golden Horn Tender (first time).
On a ledge of a ruined building down the nearby hole lies a corpse with the Shattered Stone Talisman.
Return to the road and kill the Ghostflame Dragon for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
Loot the Repeating Crossbow from a corpse next to the road where the enemies were fighting.
Follow the road to a fort and grab the Moorth Highway, South grace on a ledge to the right.
At the end of the cliff southwest of the grace sits a corpse with a Rune Arc.
Head back and enter the Fort of Reprimand:
Kill the Omenkiller near the entrance for Blessed Bone Shard x3 (first time).
Grab the 2x Broken Rune, Throwing Dagger x8, Ghost Glovewort [6], Blessed Bone Shard, and Redflesh Mushroom x5 in the area.
Go down the stairs to find a Fireproof Pickled Liver on the left.
Descend the ladder in the middle room for a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x3 outside the cell.
Inside the cell is a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x6 and a chest with Sunwarmth Stone x3 and Smithing Stone [7] x6.
Climb back up and grab the Festive Grease x2 next to the stairs.
Before going up the stairs, climb the cages near the corpse to reach a chest with the Flamedrake Talisman +3.
Go up the stairs, then grab the Broken Rune on the left, guarded by an Omenkiller that drops Blessed Bone Shard x4 (first time).
Continue up the stairs and pick up Dewgem x3 from the corpse slumped over a crenel.
Activate the Fort of Reprimand grace up the last set of stairs.
West of the grace, on a wooden platform extending past the rampart, lies a Blessed Bone Shard.
Drop down into the hole west-southwest of the grace to find a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Kill the Omenkiller around the corner to obtain an Iris of Occultation (first time).
Pick up the Knot Resin x6, Broken Rune, and Marika's Rune from the pile of corpses.
Continue outside to find the Messmer Soldier Ashes in front of some gravestones.
Head up the ladder and kill Black Knight Edredd for Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and 80,000 runes.

links.label: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings

steps.text: Climb your way to the top for a chest with the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2].
Kill the first Abductor Virgin outside the fort for Broken Rune x5, Shadow Realm Rune [2], and a Shadow Realm Rune [3] (first time).
Kill the malfunctioned Abductor Virgin for Broken Rune x4, Shadow Realm Rune [1] x2, and a Shadow Realm Rune [4] (first time).
On a ledge near the Abductor Virgins lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x8.
Pick up the Blessing of Marika on the cliff near the fort wall.
Jump down the spiritspring below the cliff using Torrent, then take it back up to discover the Behind the Fort of Reprimand grace.
Climb the ladder past the grace to reach a chest containing an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Travel to the Main Gate Cross and talk to Moore to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [7].
Talk to Ansbach about the cross where the eye was abandoned, then talk to him again to hear his conclusion.
Talk to Leda and ask her about the silent monk.
On the edge of the pond northeast of the Moorth Ruins grace lies a Four-Toed Fowl Foot.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment below the statue at the north end of the water.
Head through the cave near the statue to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3], Shadow Sunflower x2, and Heal from Afar.
After exiting the cave, stick to the right side to find a Forager Brood by the cliff. Interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [5] and Pearlescent Scale.
Pick up the Gravebird Anklets by the stone arch near the Forager Brood.
Head west to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2 near another arch.
Continue past the arch to reach a ruin-strewn clearing with the Ancient Ruins Base grace.
Follow the road northeast of the grace to a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Shoot down the scarab hanging from a pillar on the side of the road to obtain Ash of War: Scattershot Throw.
Follow the road to a forge, then kill the scarab up on the right-side ledge for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Go back and enter Taylew's Ruined Forge:
Head inside and activate the Taylew's Ruined Forge grace.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from the first area.
Continue across the short bridge for a Smithing Stone [5] beside a brazier.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] at the bottom of a ladder.
Go down the stairs and enter the room across the gap for a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithscript Axe.
Head below the gap to find a Smithing Stone [1] and a Smithing Stone [4].
Jump to the area on the other side of the pipe to pick up Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithscript Greathammer.
Go up the pipe, then jump to the area on the left to find Smithing Stone [8] x2, Smithing Stone [6] (below), Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Jump back to the pipe and onto the area on the right. Go through the south-southwest corridor and up to the second floor for a Smithing Stone [4], 2x Smithing Stone [6], and the Smithscript Shield.
Loot the 2x Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [4], and Smithing Stone [1] on the ground floor.
Jump over the nearby balustrade to reach a corridor with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] at the end of the corridor.
Climb the ladder in the corridor, then jump over the gap to a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Hop back across and go up the stairs to reach a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [6], and the pipe lever.
Pull the lever, then drop down the raised platform and take the west-northwest corridor to a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [6], and Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Make your way to the top of the pipe, then jump to the area on the left for a Smithing Stone [6].
Climb the ladder and examine the altar to obtain Taylew the Golem Smith and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Kill the Bloodfiend Hexer in the pond west-southwest of the forge for the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear (first time).
Pick up Sacred Bloody Flesh x3, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Sanguine Amaryllis x5 from the two corpses in the water.
A Shadow Realm Rune [3] lies on a ledge between the cliff and a pillar, southwest of the pond.
Kill the Chief Bloodfiend for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time), then pick up another Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 from the cave.
A small campsite lies just south of the cave. Loot the Pearl Shield Talisman from a chest under the canopy.
Return to Ancient Ruins Base and pass time until nightfall. Head west-southwest to find Rauh Burrow on top of a fallen stone structure.
Continue southwest to find another corpse with Rauh Burrow in the middle of the ravine.
Follow the right side of the ravine up a slope to reach a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x4
On the other side of the ravine, near the cliff, is a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
West-southwest of the spiritgraves is a sealed spiritspring. Hit the stacked stones at the top of the ledge to unseal it.
Take the spiritsprings up, then enter the mausoleum and kill Red Bear for Red Bear's Claw, Iron Rivet Set, and 80,000 runes.
Jump back down the spiritsprings, then follow the road to a stele with Map: Rauh Ruins.
Continue until you reach the water, then head south toward a slanted ruin with Smithing Stone [5] x6 on top of it.
Pick up the Spiritgrave Stone x3 behind the ruined wall northwest of the slanted ruin.
Head north-northwest from the ruined wall to discover the Temple Town Ruins grace.
From the grace, head south-southwest and follow the right wall to a Grave Glovewort [8] near some gravestones by the cliff.
Follow the cliff edge until you reach a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Look for a hole in the wall north of the statue to find the way inside Temple Town Ruins:
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [6] from the corpse in the back corner.
Turn back to find Beast Blood x3 on some roof tiles next to the entrance hole.
Go up the stairs, then turn around and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for Rauh Burrow x4 and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Pick up a Scadutree Fragment from the corpse slumped over the covered bridge.
Head across the second bridge for a corpse with Arrow x10 on the left.
Loot the Two-Handed Sword Talisman from the chest at the end.
Head up the slope north of the Temple Town Ruins grace to find Whiteflesh Mushroom x5 on a ledge.
Use the spiritspring near the corpse while facing south to reach a chest with Beast Horn x2.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x3 on the wall behind the chest.
Jump over the gap below the wall and follow the tunnel to a building with Divine Bird Warrior Ornis.
Return to the grace and head north-northwest up the slope on the left side to find Gravebird's Blackquill Armor at the top.
Pick up Preserving Boluses x2 from the island with a giant pillar in the middle of the river.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the alcove east of the island for Fire Spritestone x3 and the Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1] (first time).
West of the alcove and on the other side of the river is a scarab that drops Ash of War: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice.

links.label: Ash of War: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice

steps.text: Activate the Ravine North grace across the river and pass time until nightfall.
Head northwest from the grace and up a slanted pillar in the woods to reach an area with two sleeping Runebears. Pick up Lump of Flesh x3, Beast Blood x2, and Throwing Dagger x5 from the rock pile.
On a ledge south-southwest of the rock pile is a corpse with the Gloried variant of the Highland Warrior Set.
Kill Rugalea the Great Red Bear for Roar of Rugalea and 210,000 runes.

Freyja's summon sign can be found nearby if she hasn't moved to the Shadow Keep. If you didn't summon her in Belurat, you can summon her now to get the additional dialogue from defeating a boss with her.
Head south down the hillside where you fought Rugalea to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Pick up Greater Potentate's Cookbook [8] from the excrement pile southwest of the blue spiritgraves.
Head down to the river and follow it to a Ghost Glovewort [6] near some coffins in the water.
At the end of the river lies the entrance to Scorpion River Catacombs:
Take the lift down and grab the Scorpion River Catacombs grace.
Pick up Rejuvenating Boluses x3 from the first room on the left.
Quickly run across the bridge and pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] down a set of stairs ahead.
Continue to a room with Redflesh Mushroom x5 and a Bigmouth Imp.
Head down two staircases and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] from the corpse below an impaling mechanism.
Drop down next to the corpse and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [4] in the short corridor.
Climb the ladder and drop down to a room with a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Return to the larger room and continue past the second impaling mechanism to find an altar with Black Knight Captain Huw.
Climb the ladder in the alcove, then face west and jump onto the impaling mechanism to reach a ledge with a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Stand on the balustrade near the other impaling mechanism to jump onto it and reach a ledge with Imp Head (Lion).
Ride the mechanism down to the Basilisk statue, then pick up Knight's Lightning Spear from the corridor.
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Yellow Fulgurbloom x6.
Take the lift below, then head past the floating eyes to reach a room with a Grave Glovewort [7].
Drop down to the right after going down the stairs for a Great Ghost Glovewort, guarded by Basilisks.
Climb the ladder and pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] in front of the coffin.
Continue past another pair of eyes, then at the bridge drop down to the right and climb the ladder to a chest with Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2].
Go through the narrow corridor and pick up the Rejuvenating Boluses x2 on the right.
Pick up the Broken Rune at the end of the upper section, then follow the eyes to the last lift.
Kill the Death Knight for Death Knight's Longhaft Axe, Cerulean Amber Medallion +3, and 130,000 runes.
Head east along the outskirts of Moorth Ruins to find a Shadow Realm Rune [3] on the roof of a tall church.
Drop down the hole next to the church to reach a building with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Pick up String x2 from the corpse on the upper floor balcony.
Drop down near the building, then turn around and follow the path to a Golden Horn Tender.
Head down the other path and pick up Golden Arcs from the chest on top of a building.
At the bottom of the building, in front of the entrance, is a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x4.
Climb the ladder at the end of the tunnel to reach Bonny Village:
Activate the Bonny Village grace near the well.
Follow the path to a Hefty Cracked Pot and a Broken Rune by some large pots on the right.
Pick up Kukri x5 and the Bonny Butchering Knife from two houses on the left side of the village.
Drop down the broken bridge to pick up Human Bone Shard x2 and Living Jar Shard x5 from three corpses.
A statue with Revered Spirit Ash sits at the northwest end of the ravine.
At the other end of the ravine, near the cliff edge, is a corpse with Raw Meat Dumpling.
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the burnt remains of a building on the other side of the village.
Follow the path near the building to a dead tree with the O Mother gesture below it.
Head across the bridge to the southeast and pick up the Tooth Whip from the shack.
Go across the second bridge and grab the Bridge Leading to the Village grace for later.
Cross the bridge southeast of the Bonny Village grace to reach the entrance to Bonny Gaol:
Head inside and activate the Bonny Gaol grace.
Enter the first room on the right for Frozen Maggot x8.
Descend the pots below the edge, then pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the second cell.
Take the pot lift back up and grab the Bolt x10 on a spiked chair.
Open the door and hop down the hole to land next to a Broken Rune.
Head east first in the tunnel to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x2 behind some stalactite.
Climb the ladder at the end and pick up the Stalwart Horn Charm +2.
Follow the other path in the tunnel to a Broken Rune at the other end.
Turn back and follow the right tunnel to an Invigorating Cured Meat and a waterfall.
Drop down the waterfall and pick up the Broken Rune next to a gate.
Pick up Lost Ashes of War from a corpse in front of a waterfall.
Drop down another waterfall and pick up the Innard Meat in front of a pot.
In the same room, pick up a Raw Meat Dumpling from the pot with a Jar Dweller inside.
Continue down some stairs to find a Silver Horn Tender on the left.
Open the door up ahead and take the pot lift down. Stay on the lift until it ascends to reach the Night Set.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Shield of Night at the end.
Return down the lift and kill Curseblade Labirith for Curseblade Meera and 100,000 runes.
Travel to Bridge Leading to the Village and head up the right side of the woods for a teleporting scarab that drops Ash of War: Raging Beast.
Note: Moving past this grace (or approaching the Shadow Keep) will break Miquella's charm. Make sure you have Thiollier's Concoction and the Forager Brood Cookbook [7] before proceeding.
Kill the Furnace Golem past the woods for the Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Follow the road to a high up ledge on the left, then shoot down the pot next to a tree for the Greasemonger's Bell Bearing.
Continue up the road until you see the Church District Highroad grace on the right.
Enter the rise near the grace and hit the stacked stones on the balcony (behind an illusory wall) to unseal the spiritspring just outside.
Use the spiritspring while facing southwest to reach the top of the rise and a chest containing Rabbath's Cannon.
Return to the grace and follow the road northwest through a tunnel to grab the Church District Entrance grace for later.
Head back and veer to the right as you exit the tunnel to reach the area above it and a Grave Glovewort [7] by some graves.
On a rock east-northeast of the graves sits a corpse with a Blessed Bone Shard.
Interact with the Forager Brood near the castle wall to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [6] and Dewgem x3.
Pass time until nightfall at the Church District Highroad, then head west to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Head southwest from the spiritgraves and follow the lower path to a room with a scarab. Shoot it down to obtain Ash of War: Carian Sovereignty.
Return to the grace and follow the other road to a cathedral. Follow the water's edge left to find a corpse with Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4].
Continue south from the cookbook to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards near the cliff.
West-northwest of the astrolabe, on the walkway along the cathedral wall, is a corpse with Glinting Nail x2.
At the edge of the water just west of the corpse is a duplication coffin you can mark on your map.
Enter the cathedral through the front entrance and grab the Cathedral of Manus Metyr grace.
Open the door and talk to Ymir to receive the Hole-Laden Necklace and the Ruins Map.
Exhaust Ymir's dialogue to unlock his inventory, then ask him about glintstone sorcery.
Talk to Jolan by a pillar in the room.
Ask Ymir about the knight in black armor.
Travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia and sound the hanging bell in the central finger formation to obtain the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.
Return to Ymir to receive Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.
Ask Ymir about the nature of the world and about Miquella.
Talk to Jolan now that you've received the second ruins map from Ymir.
Reload the area to find Ymir in the graveyard outside. Listen to his monologue to make him return to his chair on the next reload.
Talk to Freyja and ask what she intends to look into. Optionally, ask her what if she becomes the enemy.
Talk to Ansbach to make him relocate to the Shadow Keep.
Talk to Moore and you'll be faced with three options:
Put it behind you:
Note: The Forager Brood remain, but Moore disappears and later returns as one of Leda's allies in the Enir-Ilim fight.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse in the arena.
Remain sad forever:
Note: The Forager Brood disappear and Moore is excluded from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Moore dies next to the Forager Brood by the Church of the Crusade. Loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
I don't know:
Note: Moore remains at his shop, and the choice is delayed until you select another option. Pick this if you don't have the first six Forager Brood cookbooks and haven't spoken to Thiollier yet.

If you don't make the choice before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off. His bell bearing can then be found where he usually sits.
Talk to Thiollier, then talk to him again after reloading the area twice to hear that he's heading south.
Exhaust Leda's dialogue and suggest the hornsent.
Exhaust Hornsent's dialogue until he leaves the Highroad Cross.
Talk to Leda after Hornsent has left.
Travel to The Fissure and enter the now open tunnel to grab the Stone Coffin Fissure grace.
Instead of heading down the first stone coffin, follow the upper right path across two gaps to find Congealed Putrescence x5.
Drop down some ledges and grab the St. Trina's Arrow x10 back near the first stone coffin.
Continue until the ground collapses, then go north for a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x2 on the cliff's edge.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from a ledge with two Bloodfiends.
Activate the Fissure Cross grace and grab the Scadutree Fragment next to the cross.
Drop down the almost vertical stone coffin west of the grace to find a Grave Glovewort [7] inside the stone coffin in front of it.
Pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina in the tunnel below the coffin.
Follow the tunnel to a ledge and pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] below it.
Go up the slope as it curves left, then continue upward to the top end of a stone coffin for a Grave Glovewort [5].
Head down the coffins to the other side, then take the first left to a Grave Glovewort [8] surrounded by explosive stone sentries.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x3 between the two coffins higher up.
Drop down the overturned coffin at the end to reach the Fissure Waypoint grace.
Around the corner southeast of the grace, on the edge of the coffin, is a corpse with a Grave Glovewort [7].
Drop down to the lower path north of the grace to find Mass of Putrescence next to a rocky bridge.
On the ledge with two Skeletons is a corpse with Congealed Putrescence x2.
Continue to the top and kill the large mound of putrescence for Smithing Stone [8] x7 and Congealed Putrescence x8 (first time).
Pick up the Dewgem x3 next to the mound of putrescence.
Kill the Misbegotten Warrior up ahead to obtain Multilayered Ring of Light.
Make your way to the last stone coffin and activate the Fissure Depths grace.
Take the plunge and kill the Putrescent Knight for Remembrance of Putrescence and 220,000 runes.
Thiollier's summon sign can be found in the arena if he has left the Pillar Path Cross.
Activate the Garden of Deep Purple grace after the fight.
Pick up St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3] from a corner in the cave.
Interact with St. Trina and imbibe her nectar six times (until she tells you to kill Miquella).
Exhaust Thiollier's dialogue and attempt to pass on St. Trina's words twice.
Reload the area to be invaded by Thiollier. Defeat him to obtain St. Trina's Smile.
Talk to Thiollier again and pass on St. Trina's words.
Kill the Furnace Golem in the encampment north of the Highroad Cross for the Crimsonburst Dried Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Pick up Drawstring Messmerfire Grease, Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3], and a Shadow Realm Rune [4] from the left side of the encampment.
On the right side of the encampment is a corpse with Ember of Messmer x6.
Head up the slope to the west of the encampment and pick up the Golden Vow x2 about halfway up.
Kill the Black Knight at the top of the slope to obtain the Black Steel Twinblade.
Head toward the elevated part of the camp on the other side to find a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x2.
Kill the exploding scarab hovering in the air for Ash of War: Rolling Sparks.
Pick up Perfumer's Bolt x20 and a Somber Smithing Stone [7] from a tent at the top of the hill.
Near the castle wall is a dead Furnace Golem. Loot the 3x Furnace Visages around it and the Furnace Keeper's Note in the tent.
Enter the castle and take the lift up to the Shadow Keep Main Gate grace.
Kill the Golden Hippopotamus for Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns, Scadutree Fragment x2, and 200,000 runes.
Freyja and Hornsent can both be summoned if you've spoken to them at least once.
Activate the Main Gate Plaza grace after the fight.
Pick up Festive Grease from a corpse next to a staircase.
Take the first right up the stairs to a room with Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Past the doorway in the room is a corpse with the Main-gauche.
Return to the stairs and continue to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x7 draped over the edge.
Grab the Golden Vow and Shadow Realm Rune [6] in the dining hall up the stairs.
Below the bridge just outside the dining hall is a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Drop down and grab the Talisman of Lord's Bestowal next to a golden tree.
Go through the doorway close to a corner to find Smithing Stone [8] x2 on a wooden platform.
Return to the tree and pick up the Golden Vow x3 guarded by a Black Knight.
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] x2 behind a weapon rack in the nearby room.
Climb the ladder in the room and open the shortcut back to the dining hall.
This time, head across the bridge and pick up the Holyproof Pickled Liver in the left-hand corner.
On a short flight of stairs past three funeral boats is a corpse with Messmerfire Grease.
Head down the long set of stairs to pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease and unlock a shortcut back to the Main Gate Plaza.
Return up the long staircase to find two summon signs on the right:

Note: To obtain all missable items in two playthroughs, you must either assist Hornsent in defeating Leda or assist Leda in killing both Hornsent and Ansbach, then do the opposite in NG+. Helping Leda kill Hornsent and later siding with Ansbach is possible, but doing so causes you to miss a unique talisman, requiring a third playthrough to get all items.
Assist Hornsent:
Note: Skips the invasion part of Leda's questline, and depending on a later decision, Hornsent can become one of Leda's allies in the Enir-Ilim fight.
Use the gold summon sign and help Hornsent defeat Leda for Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.
Assist Needle Knight Leda:
Note: Ends Hornsent's questline and excludes him from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Use the red summon sign and kill Hornsent for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Talk to Leda to receive the Lacerating Crossed-Tree, then speak to her again.
Talk to Leda after reloading the area, and she'll name Ansbach as her next target.
Pick up the Rada Fruit, Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot, and Smithing Stone [8] x3 by the funeral boats.
Descend the ladder near the boats, then go past the waterfall to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Behind the waterfall you passed is a ladder that leads to a painting. Examine it to obtain the "Domain of Dragons" Painting.
Hit the illusory wall nearby, then rest in the coffin at the end. Grab the Castle Watering Hole grace for later.
Return to the Main Gate Plaza shortcut and pick up the Bone Dart x8 and Smithing Stone [7] x2 up the stairs.
Take the lift past the Fire Knight to reach the Storehouse, First Floor grace.
Head through the doorway on the left to pick up a Rune Arc.
Take the lift down, then go straight ahead for a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Enter the corridor near the lift, then take a left to a balcony with Ash of War: Wall of Sparks.

links.label: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks

steps.text: Hit the illusory wall next to a staircase to find the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [4].
Go downstairs and pick up the Innard Meat between two pots.
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot and an Iris of Grace from the infirmary.
Continue past the infirmary to grab the West Rampart grace for later.
Return to Storehouse, First Floor and climb the horned beast to reach the Revered Spirit Ash on top of it.
On the floor near the beast's skull is a corpse with Fireproof Pickled Liver.
Follow the narrow path east of the corpse to a secluded area with the Boltdrake Talisman +3.
Pull the lever to find a corpse with Ember of Messmer x2 behind an empty shelving unit.
Head up the stairs and grab the Fire Coil below the bridge on the right.
Enter the nearby room to find a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3 in front of some skeletal remains.
Exhaust Ansbach's dialogue in the same room.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x5 guarded by a Fire Knight at the end of the first floor.
Go up the stairs to the second floor and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x4 on the wooden walkway.
Pick up the Beast Horn x4 and Black Pyrefly x4 on the second floor.
On the third floor, head west to pick up a Beast Horn that's guarded by a Fire Knight.
Next to some stone tablets at the other end is a Blessed Bone Shard.
Pick up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy from a corpse on the wooden walkway.
On a ledge attached to the walkway is a corpse with the Dueling Shield.
This shield is equipped with Ash of War: Shield Strike. Remove it to make it available for compatible shields.
Grab the Lump of Flesh x2 and Beast Horn x4 in the section past the balcony.
Climb the crucified specimen to reach the fourth floor. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and Storehouse Cross Message, then grab the Storehouse, Fourth Floor grace.
Head outside and pick up the Stormhawk Feather x3 on the right.
Next to a staircase and a funeral boat up ahead is a corpse with Black Pyrefly x4.
Continue to a staircase that leads downward. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [5] next to it.
Grab the Holyproof Pickled Liver and Secret Rite Scroll in the room by the staircase.
Head back outside and pick up the Redflesh Mushroom x6 and Ember of Messmer x3 at the end.
Go left when heading inside to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x4.
Head down the other way and pick up the Fire Coil x2 behind a shelving unit.
Continue to a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3 around a corner.
Pick up a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot on the staircase to the sixth floor.
In the room straight ahead, you'll find a Spirit Calculus guarded by a Fire Knight.
Pick up the Sliver of Meat x2 up two sets of stairs and grab the Storehouse, Seventh Floor grace.
Talk to Freyja in front of the fireplace.
Climb onto the horned beast across the wooden bridge for a Revered Spirit Ash.
Pick up the Ember of Messmer x5 and Shadow Realm Rune [5] on the floor below the beast.
Pull the lever to shift the central mechanism, then climb it outside. Go up the stairs and pick up Ember of Messmer x3 from the eighth floor.
Kill Fire Knight Kood on the bridge to obtain the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment behind the door, then activate the Dark Chamber Entrance grace for later.
Head back outside to the bridge, then walk off the ledge down the stairs to reach a platform with Impenetrable Thorns.
Tell Ansbach about Freyja's decision first. Then give him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhaust his dialogue.
Reload the area and talk to Ansbach to receive the Letter for Freyja.
Give the letter to Freyja, then talk to her to receive the Golden Lion Shield.
Note: If you want to exclude her from the fight in Enir-Ilim, you must kill her before reloading the area.
Talk to Ansbach and pass on Freyja's message.
Make your way up to the wooden walkway on the third floor and loot the Pearldrake Talisman +3 from the crucified specimen.
If you helped Leda kill Hornsent, you'll find two summon signs in Ansbach's room:
Assist Ansbach:
Note: Skips this part of Leda's questline.
Use the gold summon sign and help Ansbach defeat Leda for Ansbach's Longbow and Leda's Rune.
Assist Needle Knight Leda:
Note: Ends Ansbach's questline and excludes him as a potential summon for Leda and her allies and Promised Consort Radahn.
Use the red summon sign and kill Ansbach for Ansbach's Set and Ansbach's Longbow.
If you didn't receive the Letter for Freyja from Ansbach before he left, you can find it at his spot.
Talk to Leda to receive the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
Travel to the Church District Entrance, then pick up Crab Eggs x2, Thin Beast Bones x4, and Strip of White Flesh x2 from the first rooftop.
Jump across the logs in the water to reach a stone platform with a Great Grave Glovewort.
Return to the rooftop, then use the dormers to jump to a building with a Fireproof Pickled Liver.
Pick up Ember of Messmer x3 and a Slumbering Egg from the next rooftop.
Climb the nearest flying buttress, then drop through the hole in the roof and pick up Stormhawk Feather x3 from the intersecting ribs.
Drop down to the first floor and pick up the Lightningproof Pickled Liver next to a crab.
Unlock the nearby door to find Queelign curled up on the floor:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Fire Knight Queelign.
Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain Queelign's Greatsword.
Go down the other path and take the first left to find a Rune of an Unsung Hero.
Before taking the second left across a bridge, pick up the Ember of Messmer x2 in the curved corridor.
Head across the bridge, then grab the Hefty Beast Bone x3 in an alcove before a ladder.
Climb the ladder and push the lever to drain the water. Drop down next to the ladder afterward for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Head left out the doorway to find a Well-Pickled Turtle Neck in a corner.
Enter the nearby ruins of a building and activate the Sunken Chapel grace.
Exit east to find a Ghost Glovewort [7], then continue along the outer wall to pick up Crab Eggs x2.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit that ambushes you near a large dead tree for Mantle of Thorns.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] next to the tree.
Go up the stairs east of the tree and optionally activate the shortcut lift back to the entrance.
In the building next to the lift is a Shadow Realm Rune [5].
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit that ambushes you northwest of the building for an Iris of Occultation.
Grab the Rada Fruit x4, Crab Eggs x2 (behind the wall), and String x6 around the street.
Pick up Kukri x6 and Smithing Stone [8] x5 from the last building.
Enter the church near the dead tree and kill Fire Knight Wego for the Death Mask Helm.
In an alcove near the entrance is a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x3.
Ride the lift in the opposite alcove, then take the first right to another lift. Take it up to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on the right.
Continue just ahead to grab the Storehouse, Back Section grace for later.
Return down the lift, then jump onto the headless statue in the middle for a Scadutree Fragment.
Drop down and pick up the Fire Knight's Seal behind the statue.
Head down the northeast corridor, then grab the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1] up the stairs.
Open the door below and take the lift down to the Tree-Worship Passage grace.
Head through the passage to find an Iris of Grace in front of a headless Marika statue.
Go down the stairs to grab the Tree-Worship Sanctum grace and a Marika's Rune.
Kill the Scadutree Avatar for Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, Miquella's Great Rune, and 260,000 runes.
Activate the Scadutree Base grace in the middle of the arena.
Travel to the Storehouse, Back Section grace and grab the Glintslab Firefly x3 and Carian Thrusting Shield past a ladder.
Climb the ladder, then turn right at the top of the stairs to find a corpse with Fire Coil x3.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] near the edge and the Fire Serpent at the end.
Head through the hole in the wall and pick up the Shadow Sunflower x6 and Blessed Bone Shard on the wooden platforms.
Continue to the top and activate the Storehouse, Loft grace.
Take the lift up and make your way to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x7 just past a ladder.
Climb the nearby ladder, then pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x4 beside a wooden pillar.
Continue along the beams, then drop down onto a wooden gear to pick up Wrath from Afar.
Jump to the other side and climb the ladder to a lift. Take it down to an area with a Rune of an Unsung Hero.
Take the lift back up, then send it down without riding it. Send the second lift down to raise the first and drop onto it as it ascends to reach a corpse with Fire Knight Hilde.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse down the next ladder.
Descend the last ladder and take the two lifts outside down to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate grace.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to a headless statue near the grace.
Kill Commander Gaius for Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider and 230,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

steps.text: Activate the Scaduview grace after the fight.
Head past the rampart and kill the Albinauric Archer near a shack for Gaius's Greaves and an Albinauric Bloodclot (first time).
Pick up the Sharpshot Talisman from a corpse in the shack.
Continue uphill to find 5x Scadutree Fragments in front of the Scadutree Chalice.
