Travel to the Dark Chamber Entrance grace and kill Messmer the Impaler for Remembrance of the Impaler, Messmer's Kindling, and 400,000 runes.
Hornsent can be summoned if you've spoken to him at least once. Successfully killing Messmer with him will cause him to invade you in Rauh Ruins, excluding him from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Jolan can be summoned instead if you've received the second ruins map from Ymir and talked to her.
Activate the Messmer's Dark Chamber grace and rest at it.
Exhaust Hornsent's dialogue in the chamber or at the Highroad Cross.
Pick up the Message from Leda at the Highroad Cross or near any of the other crosses.
Talk to Hornsent Grandam to receive a Gourmet Scorpion Stew.
Exhaust Hornsent Grandam's dialogue, then reload the area to find a Gourmet Scorpion Stew in front of her.
Use the O Mother gesture in front of the statue near the Shadow Keep, Back Gate grace to reveal a path to the Hinterland grace.
Kill the first Tree Sentinel past the grace for a Blessing of Marika, then kill the second for another blessing and 120,000 runes.
Jolan can be summoned if you've received the second ruins map from Ymir and talked to her.
Head up the slope near the first Tree Sentinel toward Shaman Village to find Minor Erdtree amidst some glowing flowers.
Pick up the Golden Braid from a dead tree at the top end of the village.
From the dead tree, head southeast and descend the lower cliff to drop onto Rabbath's Rise and find a puppet of Anna. Drop below the puppet to pick up the Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing.
Return to the Hinterland and follow the path across a bridge to grab the Hinterland Bridge grace.
Drop down twice southeast of the grace to find Pearlescent Scale, Shadow Sunflower x3, and Fingerprint Nostrum x2 in the right-hand corner.
Head back to the road and activate the Fingerstone Hill grace on a ledge by the roadside.
Kill the Fallingstar Beast in the crater northeast of the grace for Gravitational Missile and 170,000 runes.
Return to the grace and make your way down to the foggy area on the left. Near the cliff edge is a corpse with The Two Fingers gesture.
Just east of the corpse is a duplication coffin you can mark on your map.
Head south from the coffin to find a large hole in the ground with the Fingercreeper Ashes inside, guarded by a massive Fingercreeper.
Continue through the tunnel to find a Shadow Realm Rune [6] on a ledge.
Head to the finger ruins and sound the hanging bell to obtain the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and exhaust Jolan's dialogue.
Talk to Ymir to receive Ruins Map (3rd), then ask him about the nature of the world.
Reload the area, then move Ymir's chair to discover a ladder to the third finger ruins, where you'll be invaded by Swordhand of Night Anna. Kill her to obtain the Claws of Night.
Return to Jolan and tell her you were attacked by a Swordhand of Night underground.
Head back underground and pick up the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2] from the lower left path.
Sound the last hanging bell and kill Metyr, Mother of Fingers for Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers and 420,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

steps.text: Activate the Finger Birthing Grounds grace in the arena.
Interact with Ymir's chair to be invaded by Swordhand of Night Jolan. Defeat her, then kill Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers for Ymir's Bell Bearing, Maternal Staff, High Priest Set, and 210,000 runes.
Pick up Cherishing Fingers from Yuri's grave outside the cathedral.
Reload the area to find Jolan slumped against the pillar from earlier:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Swordhand of Night Jolan.
Return to the puppet in Rabbath's Rise from Shaman Village and usher Anna into the ashes to obtain Jolan and Anna.

Note: The puppet can only be used if you've given Jolan the Iris of Grace in the same playthrough. Anna cannot be combined with Jolan's ashes from a previous NG cycle, and Jolan and Anna cannot be separated after entering NG+.
Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain the Sword of Night.
Travel to the Castle Watering Hole grace and pick up the Furnace Visage just east of it.
In the hand of an inactive Furnace Golem farther east is another Furnace Visage.
Kill the Furnace Golem to the southwest for the Oil-Soaked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Return to the grace and pick up the 10x Furnace Visages around the Furnace Golem remains.
Pick up Ember of Messmer x5 from the balcony of a building in the water.
By the cliff behind the building sits a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Head north from the statue to a thin wall with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3 behind it.
Continue north around the ruins wall to further explore the Ruins of Unte:
Pick up the Lost Ashes of War on top of a wall, accessible from the second floor of a building.
Continue up the rooftops to reach a balcony with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Throw a Hefty Furnace Pot into the inactive Furnace Golem, then kill it for the Bloodsucking Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Pick up Giant Golden Arc from the chest in the shrine.
Outside the shrine is a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Darkness (if you got it in Fog Rift Catacombs).

Note: Once turned in, the Stone-Sheathed Sword cannot be reacquired until NG+ (though its light and dark variants can still be swapped at their respective steles). If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Darkness is instead acquired at the stele in Fog Rift Catacombs.
Head to the waterfall south of the ruins and grab the Recluses' River Upstream grace beside it.
Follow the cliffside path across two gaps to find Thin Beast Bones x6 at the end.
Cross the gap to the other side, then head west for Fly Mold x4.
Follow the other direction until you see a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2.
Drop down to activate the Recluses' River Downstream grace.
Shoot down the hanging pot northeast of the grace; you'll collect it in a later step.
From the grace, keep right along the northern path to a grassy field with Fly Mold x3 on the edge.
In the cliff behind the corpse is a small cave with Nascent Butterfly x2.
Continue northwest along the upper path, then drop down once at the end to pick up the Dryleaf Seal.
Drop down until you reach the top of the waterfall (no lower), then follow the river upstream to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and a Scadutree Fragment at the end.
Head back and pick up Dane's Set under the waterfall.
Just east-southeast of the waterfall is a corpse with a Human Bone Shard.
Kill the scarab just past the corpse to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Continue to a mausoleum and kill Rakshasa for Rakshasa's Great Katana, Rakshasa Set, and 90,000 runes.
Follow the river to the other end to pick up the Moldmonger's Bell Bearing you shot down earlier.
Pick up the Glass Shard between two bushes beside the top of the waterfall.
Descend the gravestones to the base of the waterfall, then head northeast until you see an alcove on your left with Scorpion Liver x4.
Kill the two Hippopotamuses in the water for 2x Scadutree Fragments.
Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x4 from the slanted island in the middle of the water.
Travel to the Recluses' River Downstream grace and head south down a multitude of drops to a grassy slope. Follow it up to reach the Village of Flies:
Pick up a Revered Spirit Ash from the statue near the top-left corner of the slope.
Just southeast of the statue is a corpse with Silver Horn Tender.
Continue to the top to find a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and Man-Fly Ashes.
Walk around the rock with the ashes to find a Golden Horn Tender.
Follow the grassy slope all the way down to reach a misty area with the Darklight Catacombs entrance:
Take the lift down and activate the Darklight Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [6] from the first room.
Continue to a room with a staircase and pull the lever below it to turn on the lights.
From the balcony ahead, jump over the railing and follow the narrow ledge to an archway below it. Loot the Viridian Amber Medallion +3 from the chest inside.
Drop onto the slope, then head south to find a Grave Glovewort [7] in a dark room.
Take the lift down the slope. Drop down straight ahead to the left of a balustrade, then climb the ladder to a Shadow Realm Rune [5]. Be wary of the Catacombs Sorcerer around the corner.
Drop down and pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] in the same room.
Go down the first flight of stairs and climb the ladder behind a wall to reach a room with a lever, then turn on the lights.
Pick up Thin Beast Bones x4 from the flight of stairs below the lever.
At the top of the stairs, drop through the gap in the balustrade to find the Death Knight Set on your left.
Descend the ladder on the opposite side and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [9] from the ledge.
Take the next lift down, then after dropping down some stairs, turn around for a Ghost Glovewort [8].
Pull the lever north of the giant Bigmouth Imp to turn on the lights and lower the middle platform.
Kill the giant Bigmouth Imp for a Great Ghost Glovewort (first time).
Note: If the Imp didn't spawn or the item is floating in the air, just come back after the boss.
Drop down behind the middle platform to discover a chest containing the Bigmouth Imp Ashes.
Climb the ladder and continue until you drop down, then turn back for a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Take the final lift and kill Jori, Elder Inquisitor for Barbed Staff-Spear and 260,000 runes.
Activate the Forsaken Graveyard grace after the fight.
Follow the path into the woods and grab the Woodland Trail grace on the side of the road.
Kill the Madding Hand patrolling the road farther south to obtain the Madding Hand.
Continue along the road to reach a stele with Map: Abyss.
Activate the Church Ruins grace in the church by the stele.
Pick up Scadutree Fragment x2 and Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle from the church.
Next to a tree north of the church entrance is a corpse with Clarifying Boluses x2.
On top of a ledge just west from the church entrance is a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
From the ledge, head south below an arched root to find a corpse with Surging Frenzied Flame and a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Keep the wall on your left as you go west-northwest. To the left of the largest tree is a corpse with Clarifying Cured Meat x2 and a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Go up the slope southeast to find a corpse with some Clarifying Boluses.
Head north-northwest and around the cliff to find a path on your left. Kill the Aging Untouchable for the Aged One's Exultation.
Note: This enemy type can only be damaged after a successful parry. [See parry guide]
Kill the Aging Untouchable farther in for a Swollen Grape.
Continue west until the area turns foggy. Kill the Aging Untouchable in the fog for a Swollen Grape.
On the south side of the foggy area is a large tree with Clarifying Boluses x3 beside it.
Travel to the Woodland Trail grace, then head straight west to find the Abyssal Woods grace.
From that grace, head toward the southeast hills to find a Shadow Realm Rune [7] between two giant trees.
Return to the Abyssal Woods grace and follow the northern path to a dead end. Pick up Clarifying Cured Meat x2, Smithing Stone [7] x2, and a Scadutree Fragment from the two corpses there.
Head back and kill the Aging Untouchable near the Abyssal Woods grace for a Swollen Grape.
Kill the last two Aging Untouchables farther west for 2x Swollen Grapes.
On a ledge overlooking the path with the two Aging Untouchables is a Great Grave Glovewort.
Drop back down and follow the path straight ahead to discover the Divided Falls grace.
Pick up the Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [1] at the top of the slope southwest of the grace.
Return to the grace, then head south-southeast below an arched slope. From there, head south-southwest and go up the long slope at the end. Pick up the Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2] at the top.
Make your way down the southwest side of the slope to discover Midra's Manse at the end.
Open the door and pick up a Swollen Grape from a side room before the grace.
Activate the Manse Hall grace in the main hall.
Hit the painting to reveal a corridor, then take the first left to a room with a Torn Diary Page.
Climb the furniture in the room to reach a corpse with Swollen Grape x2.
Enter the dining hall at the end of the corridor and pick up the Thin Beast Bones x4 by the fireplace.
Head down the next corridor and pull the lever at the end.
Climb the ladder behind the bookcase that moved to find a Shadow Realm Rune [6] on some beams.
Pick up Surging Frenzied Flame x3 from the other side of the second floor balcony.
Climb the ladder on the balcony to continue, then pick up Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3] from a dark room next to the wooden beams.
Cross the beams to the other side and activate the Midra's Library grace.
On top of a bookcase in the library is a corpse with Golden Horn Tender x2.
Jump onto the bookcase below the corpse for a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
Drop to the floor and grab the Swollen Grape x2 at the west end of the library.
Go through the doorway at the opposite end and open the shortcut back to the Manse Hall grace.
Hit the painting near the shortcut to reveal a path to a lever. Pull it to move the last bookcase into place.
Make your way across the bookcases to reach a corpse with Nanaya's Torch.
Kill the large Inquisitor below for a Revered Spirit Ash (first time).
Continue through the eastern doorway to reach the Second Floor Chamber grace.
Kick down the shortcut ladder, then jump onto the chandelier to pick up a Revered Spirit Ash.
Kill Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame for Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame and 410,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

steps.text: Activate the Discussion Chamber grace after the fight.

Travel to the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace and return where you killed the drake. Follow the northeastern path to a spiritspring, then head north from it to find Greater Potentate's Cookbook [6] on the cliff edge.
Take the spiritspring up, then grab the Foot of the Jagged Peak grace across the bridge.
Kill the Jagged Peak Drake (fighting another) for Dragon Heart, Dragonscale Flesh, and 120,000 runes.
Talk to Igon after the fight to receive Igon's Furled Finger.
Take the two spiritsprings ahead to a corpse with Red Fulgurbloom x8.
Head up the slope with two rolling boulders to find a Scadutree Fragment where they first hit the ground.
Kill Ancient Dragon Senessax for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 200,000 runes.
Continue up a steep slope of dead drakes to reach the Jagged Peak Mountainside grace.
A corpse with Igon's Cookbook [2] sits at the edge of the cliff northeast of the grace.
From the grace, head southwest to a spiritspring and take it up. When safe, drop down onto the lower right path and follow it in the opposite direction to find Rock Heart (painting reward).
Return up the spiritspring, then use the next spiritspring while facing north to reach a ledge that leads to a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Use the spiritspring while facing east, then continue straight ahead to an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Take the last spiritspring and activate the Jagged Peak Summit grace.
Talk to Florissax and ask her about Igon.
Before fighting Bayle, choose how to conclude Florissax's questline:
Do nothing:
After killing Bayle, pick up Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel from where she stood.
Use Thiollier's concoction:
Pass time until she appears at night, then use Thiollier's concoction on her.
Pass time again until she wakes back up, then talk to her.
Talk to her after killing Bayle to be rewarded with Dragonbolt of Florissax.
Confess to putting her to sleep, then talk to her again and choose to take her with you to obtain Ancient Dragon Florissax.
Kill Bayle the Dread for Heart of Bayle and 490,000 runes.
Igon can be summoned for an epic fight if you got his furled finger.
Activate the Rest of the Dread Dragon grace after the fight.
Return to Igon and pick up Igon's Greatbow, Igon's Set, and Igon's Bell Bearing from his corpse.
If you received Igon's Furled Finger, his bow comes equipped with a unique ash of war. You can remove it to make Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt available for compatible bows.

links.label: Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt

steps.text: Travel to the West Rampart grace and open the smaller door. Pick up the first three items on the bridge: Smithing Stone [7] x3, Beast Liver x3, and Beast Blood x3.
Rush to the end of the bridge on horseback to kill Fire Knight Salza for Salza's Hood and Rain of Fire.
Grab the remaining items on the bridge: Somber Smithing Stone [6], Thin Beast Bones x8, Redflesh Mushroom x5, and Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] in the room at the end of the bridge.
Go up the stairs and take the lift to the Viaduct Minor Tower grace.
Follow the southeast path to a lift. On a pillar behind it is a corpse with Spirit Calculus.
Take the lift down, then pick up Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 and a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the room around the corner.
Head out the narrow passage while keeping to the right to find Thin Beast Bones x8 at the end.
Turn back and kill the Hippopotamus down the stairs for a Scadutree Fragment.
Return to the grace and walk around the right side of the tower to find a Golden Horn Tender.
Back at the grace, follow the western path to an ancient ruins entrance. Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner inside for a Revered Spirit Ash and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Climb the root at the start of the room to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Head left at the giant door to find a Fire Spritestone on a ledge.
Open the door and continue to a Shadow Realm Rune [5] beside the left wall.
Hit the illusory wall between two braziers northeast of the rune to discover an area with a Bondstone and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [2].
Continue down some stairs for a Broken Rune and a pot-carrying Shadow Commoner that drops Spirit Calculus x3 (first time).
Open the giant door to find a corpse with Rauh Burrow x5 right behind it.
Ignore the path behind the door. Instead, go through the narrow passage in the earlier room. Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from a heap of rocks in the sand.
Heading into the large room, pick up Throwing Dagger x5 from the second corner on the left.
Next to the corner is a corridor that leads to a corpse with Glass Shard on the left.
Past the corpse is a room with Sliver of Meat x2, Spider Scorpion Ashes, and Scorpion Liver x3.
Continue to find a corpse with Dewgem x2 by some flowers.
Return to the large room and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the second corridor on the right for a Scadutree Fragment and a Golden Horn Tender (first time).
Jump down the spiritspring and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [6] behind it.
At the opposite end of the room, head northeast to pick up the Fine Crucible Feather Talisman from a root.
Head down the other path and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [7] up on a ledge underway.
Keep to the left until you find Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind next to a waterfall.
Pick up the Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment by the Miquella's Cross to the southwest, then grab the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East grace.
Kill Crucible Knight Devonia near the grace for Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm.
Quickly pick up Dewgem x4 and Flight Pinion x2 from the upper half of the bridge.
Kill the Furnace Golem for the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Go south up a short hill to find the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace by the cliff.
Head into the ruins and pick up Kukri x6 from the first flight of stairs.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the room upstairs for Spirit Calculus x3 (first time).
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar in the room.
Head through the southwest corridor to find a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x2.
Take the lift up, then drop down twice to the left of it to reach a corpse with Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3.

Head across the thin platforms to a lift, but don't take it up yet. Instead, continue southeast across more platforms to reach a narrow passage. Open the chest inside to obtain the Talisman of All Crucibles.
Return through the next passage, then take the lift up to the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway grace.
Going down the stairs, hug the right side until you see a corpse with Spirit Calculus at the cliff's edge.
Return to the stairs and grab the Smithing Stone [7] x3 guarded by two dogs.
At the end of the stairway, drop down and continue to a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
Drop down southeast and kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion for Divine Beast Tornado and 180,000 runes.
Travel to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace and return to the altar. This time, head outside and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash in a gazebo.
Continue to an area with scarlet rot, then take the lift on the left side. Pick up the Scarlet Bud x6 to the right of a staircase.
Behind the staircase is a corpse with Pest-Thread Spears.
If you killed Messmer with Hornsent's help and exhausted his dialogue afterward, he'll invade on the staircase. Kill him for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Activate the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace up the stairs for later.

links.label: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance

steps.text: Go back down the stairs and out the southeast exit, hugging the left wall until you see some stacked stones. Destroy them to unseal the spiritspring below.
From the stones, head south-southwest and pick up Divine Bird Feathers from a corpse in the water.
Jump onto the roof of the gazebo east-southeast of the corpse to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Drop down and head back through the scarlet rot to find Dappled White Cured Meat x2 at the end.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x6, Immunizing Cured Meat x3, and Fly Mold x4 in the scarlet rot.
Head outside to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9] on some rocks beside the wall.
Cross the invisible bridge to reach a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Darkness) into the Sword of Light.
Note: If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Light is instead acquired at the stele in the Ruins of Unte.

Jump to the plateau beside the bridge, then, facing its west-southwest edge, drop down twice to an area with red trees. Continue down to a lift, then go past it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on some rocks.
Pick up Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom from a corpse guarded by Miranda flowers at the end.
Head back to the lift and take it up to a pot-carrying Shadow Commoner that drops a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Drop down and go out the south-southeast exit to find Knot Resin x3 behind the second pillar.
Go up the first flight of stairs, then head northeast and kill the Chief Bloodfiend accompanied by dogs for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time).
Pick up a Golden Horn Tender from the corpse between two of the pillars.
Use the spiritspring in the middle while facing east, then pick up Beast Horn x2 from the roof of some connecting pillars to the south.
Head up the final sets of stairs to reach a chest containing the Mottled Necklace +2.
Travel to the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace and kill Romina, Saint of the Bud for Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud and 380,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

steps.text: Dryleaf Dane's summon sign can be found next to the road outside.
Activate the Church of the Bud grace after the fight.
Continue ahead and use Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree.
After burning the Sealing Tree to end up in Enir-Ilim, turn around for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Activate the Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall grace next to the shut door and rest at it.
Travel to the Temple Town Ruins grace, then head up to the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. Halfway down the slope southwest of it, you'll now find the Spiraltree Seal (painting reward).
Return to Enir-Ilim and make your way into a tower with the First Rise grace inside.
Continue down the corridor to find some Messmerfire Grease on a flight of stairs.
You can send the shortcut lift down to Belurat, but it is already usable from both ends.
Head up the stairs near the grace to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a broken span.
Drop down from the roofs and go up the stairs. Pick up a Broken Rune from the ash on the right.
Jump over a branch in the nearby room to find a Rune Arc on a small altar.
Kill the large Inquisitor circling the fountain for a Revered Spirit Ash (first time).
Pick up the Budding Horn x4 surrounded by a group of Inquisitors.
In the courtyard's eastern corner is a corpse with Lightningproof Pickled Liver x2.
Looking north, jump over the fence to land next to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x8.
Circle around the tree to pick up Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Follow one of the tree's roots to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x4.
Pick up the Revered Spirit Ash x2 guarded by Man-Flies at the end.
Head up the stairs in the courtyard to continue. Before you encounter the Divine Beast Warrior, drop down onto the same tree for Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3 behind you as you drop.
Follow the tree's northern branch to a separate platform. Pick up Spira from the altar.
Past the Divine Beast Warrior is a corpse with a Dragonbolt Grease.
Head up the first set of stairs, then pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease from the left alcove.
Quickly grab the Fire Arrow x10 and Golden Bolt x10 when running up the rest of the stairs.
Open the door, pick up the Scadutree Fragment, and activate the Spiral Rise grace.
Head back and down the stairs in the other alcove to discover a room with the Inquisitor Ashes.
To the right when exiting the room, jump down onto a bridge for Fireproof Pickled Liver x2.
From the tower, drop down and make your way across the arches to reach a Holyproof Pickled Liver.
Drop through the broken arch to land near a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
At the other end, drop down to another ledge and follow it up to a corpse with Lordsworn's Bolt x10.
Follow the ledge down to drop onto a staircase, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the tower.
Pick up the Fireproof Pickled Liver just down the stairs.
Do a running jump to the window below to land in Belurat. Head outside for a Scadutree Fragment.
Up the northeastern stairs is a lift that takes you back to Enir-Ilim.
Take the lift down the southeastern stairs, then continue until you reach a door with the Euporia inside.
Return to the Spiral Rise grace and go up the stairs to reach the rooftops. Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x5 from a raised roof on the right.
Continue to a room on the left with the last Revered Spirit Ash.
From the stairs, jump over the railing to land on a staircase with a Silver Horn Tender.
Pick up Horned Warrior Ashes, Stanching Boluses, and Neutralizing Boluses x2 from the room ahead.
Climb the ladder to a corpse with a Golden Horn Tender hanging from the broken balustrade.
Climb the second ladder to get the high ground on the Divine Beast Warrior. In the room to the northwest, you'll find a Scadutree Fragment.
In the corner east of the room is a corpse with Sunwarmth Stone x2.
Continue up to a tower, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] at the bottom of the stairs.
Use the lift up the stairs while facing south-southwest. Jump off halfway to grab the Gravebird Helm. (If you failed the jump, it can also be reached from the broken staircase near the lift.)
Drop down, then head outside for a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the end.
Take the lift back up, then kill the final Divine Beast Warrior for the Horned Warrior's Greatsword.
Activate the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace and grab the last Scadutree Fragment.
Note: This is your last chance to decide Moore's fate, pass St. Trina's final words to Thiollier, deliver Freyja's letter, and give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll before exhausting his dialogue.
Enter the chamber and kill Needle Knight Leda and her allies for Leda's Sword and 300,000 runes.

links.label: Needle Knight Leda and her allies

steps.text: Thiollier can be summoned if you passed on St. Trina's final words after his invasion. Summoning him unlocks a dialogue option with Ansbach (if he is also summoned).

Ansbach can be summoned if you gave him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhausted his dialogue. Summoning him causes him to appear before the final battle, allowing you to speak with him for some extra dialogue.
Sanguine Noble Nataan can be summoned if Ansbach is not available.
If Moore appeared in the fight, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
If Freyja appeared in the fight, loot Freyja's Greatsword and Freyja's Set from her corpse.
If Hornsent appeared in the fight, loot the Falx and the Hornsent Set from his corpse.
Pick up Dane's Footwork from Dryleaf Dane's corpse.
Pick up Leda's Armor from her corpse beyond the room.
If you summoned Ansbach, he appears at the top of the last lift. Ask him about Mohg's death. If you also summoned Thiollier, you can also ask him about Thiollier.
Head up the final set of stairs to activate the Divine Gate Front Staircase grace.
Kill Promised Consort Radahn for Remembrance of a God and a Lord and 500,000 runes.

links.label: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

steps.text: Thiollier's and Ansbach's summon signs can be found outside the entrance if they were each summoned against Leda and her allies.
Activate the Gate of Divinity grace and rest at it to reload the area.
Pick up Thiollier's Hidden Needle and Thiollier's Set from his corpse.
Pick up Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, and Furious Blade of Ansbach from his corpse.
If you didn't die to Radahn's grab attack, pick up the Let Us Go Together gesture beside the memory.
Touch Miquella's memory to view a short cutscene and obtain the Circlet of Light.
Travel to the Garden of Deep Purple grace and pick up St. Trina's Blossom from St. Trina's corpse.

If you forgot to make the choice for Moore's questline and he is still at the Main Gate Cross, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off for the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set. Pick up Moore's Bell Bearing from where he usually sits.
Congratulations on completing Shadow of the Erdtree! Now return to the base game or prepare for NG+.
